exposure: Basic Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) course participation
outcome: Effectiveness of the Basic NRP course
cohort: Participants who attended the Basic Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) course, comprising online video modules and offline workshops, across India.
finding: Participants reported improved neonatal resuscitation skills and increased opportunities and facilities to practice after completing the Basic NRP course.
cross-section timing: Data collected between October 2023 and November 2023 for courses held from May 2022 to April 2023.
